label: July 27 – August 2, 2026
intro: Double public holiday mid-week (Asalha Bucha Wed + Khao Phansa Thu) plus the Pattaya International Fireworks Festival making the Aug 1–2 weekend a potential overnight adventure.

activities.title: Pattaya International Fireworks Festival
activities.time: Evening shows; beach area free from afternoon
activities.location: Pattaya Beach, Pattaya (about 2 hrs from Bangkok by bus or car)
activities.price: Free beachfront viewing; food vendors on site
activities.why: International fireworks teams competing with giant synchronized shows over the sea — Thor will lose his mind over the explosions, colors, and crowds. Beach + food + epic fireworks = perfect 5-year-old adventure. Make it an overnight stay at a beach hotel.
activities.tip: Drive or take a bus from Ekkamai Bus Terminal (~120 THB one way). Arrive by 5pm to grab a good beach spot before dark. Earplugs for sensitive ears — the shows are loud.

activities.title: Asalha Bucha Candle Ceremony at Wat Arun
activities.time: Morning ceremonies from 7am; evening candlelight from 6:30pm
activities.location: Wat Arun (Temple of Dawn), Rattanakosin Island
activities.price: Wat Arun entry ~100 THB adults; free under 10
activities.why: Thousands of candles, monks in golden procession, and spires glowing over the Chao Phraya — a genuine once-a-year spectacle. Cross the river on a long-tail boat for extra adventure. Thor gets history, culture, and a river ride all in one.
activities.tip: Morning is cooler and calmer. Evening candlelight (after 6:30pm) is more spectacular but busier. Grab iced Thai tea and satay from the riverside vendors after.

activities.title: Toob North Holiday Workshop Sessions — Cloud 11
activities.price: Free to browse; workshop sessions priced individually
activities.why: Two mid-week holidays = prime workshop time without burning a weekend. Northern Thai potters, weavers, and food artisans from Chiang Mai are still in residence. Watch live clay work and try hands-on sessions — perfect building & making outing.
activities.tip: Holiday weekdays are busier than normal weekdays but less crowded than weekends. Get there at opening.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand
activities.date: Saturday or Sunday — book ahead on Klook
activities.location: Mega Bangna, Bang Phli, Samut Prakan (BTS On Nut + Grab ~30 min)
activities.why: If you're not doing Pattaya this weekend, Marvel is the backup plan — Iron Man's Stark Mobile Lab, 4D dome, VR flight training, and meet-and-greets with Iron Man, Thor the Avenger, Hulk, and Spider-Man. Holiday weeks can get busy — book early.
activities.tip: Book on Klook ahead of time. Asalha Bucha holiday weekend can sell out. Arrive 15 mins early. Allow 2 hours.

activities.title: Roller Dome Emporium — Weekend Session
activities.location: Roller Dome, Emporium Mall, Sukhumvit Soi 24 (Phrom Phong BTS)
activities.price: 150 THB/hr weekends; skate + protective gear included
activities.why: Regular rollerblading practice keeps Thor's skill building. Dedicated grass practice area for beginners, coaches available. Great fallback if you're not heading to Pattaya.
activities.tip: Post-holiday weekends can be busy — arrive at 10am opening to skate in peace.

activities.title: Kad Kokoa Kids Bonbon Chocolate Workshop
activities.price: Check website for current session price
activities.why: Small-group kids bonbon-making workshop using real Thai craft chocolate. Thor makes his own chocolates and takes them home — pure building & making joy. Book the August slot now before it fills.
activities.tip: Follow Kad Kokoa on LINE Official to get notified the moment August dates go live.
